source:
@@U02755@@
Any two would suffice
for a monumental building.

@@U02757@@
So that’s what they call Classical!
I’m at a loss to know what to praise.
It’s clumsy, ponderous is what it is!
What’s crude is called noble,
and what’s awkward, grand.
Give me slender pillars anytime,
pillars striving upward into infinity,
pointed arches that lift the spirit on high.
Now that’s an edifying style!

@@U02759@@
Welcome and reverence these star-favored hours!
Let reason be held in abeyance by magic’s power,
and audacious fantasy in glorious progress
come freely from afar.
Behold the scene you so boldly desired.
It is impossible, therefore worthy of belief.

@@U02760@@
(浮士德 mounts to the proscenium on the other side.)

@@U02761@@
A wreath on his head and in priestly garments,
the man of miracles accomplishes now
what he so confidently began.
A tripod rises with him out of the depths,
and already I smell incense from its brazier.
He now prepares to bless the Great Work.
Only good fortune may attend him now.

@@U02763@@
(Grandly.)

@@U02764@@
In your name, Mothers,
you who sit enthroned in the Boundless,
who dwell eternally in Solitude,
yet in company!
translation:
@@U02755@@
任何两个就足够了
对于一座纪念性建筑。

@@U02757@@
这就是他们所说的古典！
我不知道该赞扬什么。
这很笨拙，很笨重！
粗陋的东西叫做高贵，
尴尬的是，伟大。
随时给我纤细的柱子，
向上延伸至无限的支柱，
尖尖的拱门将精神提升到高处。
现在这是一种启发性的风格！

@@U02759@@
欢迎并崇敬这些明星青睐的时刻！
让魔法的力量暂时搁置理性，
和辉煌进步中的大胆幻想
自由地从远方而来。
看看你如此大胆渴望的场景。
这是不可能的，因此值得相信。

@@U02760@@
（浮士德登上另一侧的舞台。）

@@U02761@@
头上戴着花环，身穿祭司服装，
创造奇迹的人现在成就了
他如此自信地开始了。
一个三脚架与他一起从深处升起，
我已经闻到了火盆里的熏香。
他现在准备祝福伟大的工作。
现在只有好运会眷顾他了。

@@U02763@@
（庄严地。）

@@U02764@@
母亲们，以你们的名义，
你坐在无边宝座上，
他们永远居住在孤独中，
还在公司！
